title: Filtering a synthetic signal (GWpy)
description: GWpy measures amplitude spectra of an original noisy two-tone signal before and after filtering. This is synthetic data, not a gravitational-wave detection.
description_ko: GWpy로 직접 만든 잡음 섞인 두 주파수 신호의 필터 전후 진폭 스펙트럼을 계산했어요. 중력파 관측이 아닌 합성 데이터예요.
prompt: Filtering a synthetic signal. Rerun the included recipe to change simulation inputs.
made_with: gwpy==4.0.2, numpy==2.2.6; executed locally on macOS arm64
